title: Cover the lid switch in the update sleep inhibitor

checks.what: the update inhibitor mask includes handle-lid-switch (low-level lock honored regardless of LidSwitchIgnoreInhibited)

knownRed: by-construction: `handle-lid-switch` appears ONLY in the ADDED lines of the systemd-inhibit mask (diff +2/−2: `--what=sleep:idle` → `--what=sleep:idle:handle-lid-switch`, in both invoke sites); the base mask is `--what=sleep:idle` alone (verified absent against ref 493067741), so the probe grep exits 2 on the golden.

markerRule.verified: marker token(s) confirmed present in the ADDED lines of the PR diff via gh api repos/omacom/omarchy/pulls/10205/files AND absent from the base-branch files (ref 493067741)
markerRule.probeExpected: probe bed (same checks, NO pr-apply) must FAIL with exit 2 on the golden; a green probe = RED-PROBE-BROKEN (process block, S7)

record.mediaNote: three-artifact contract: record start→drive→stop (.cast, artifact_min_bytes 200), record gif render (.gif), spice record action start (fps 5) → drive → stop (/tmp/pr-10205.mjpeg, artifact_min_bytes 10000, artifact_not_uniform true) + ONE run: ffmpeg transcode to /tmp/pr-10205-screen.mp4. NOTE: the spice MJPEG is written HOST-side by the SPICE-wire plugin; the in-venue run: ffmpeg step reports when the guest copy is absent and the host runner performs the container transcode (lane: EVAL RUNNER assembles media/<pr>-<calver>/).
